product.title: Jimmy Saville Face Mask Celebrity FANCY DRESS HEN BIRTHDAY PARTY FUN STAG DO HEN
product.descriptionHtml:
Our Jimmy Saville face mask is a quick way to get everyone laughing, whether it's for an Oscars-style party or a fancy dress night out. It's a firm favourite with film fans, and it travels flat in an envelope so it's easy to post as a gift.

Jimmy Saville Celebrity Face Mask

Printed in full colour on 350gsm silk card and cut to shape, the mask comes with the eye holes already cut out, plus elastic and sticky tabs for a quick fit. Can't find the face you need? We also make custom masks from your own photo.

Why you'll love it

  • Full A4 size (297 x 210 mm), so it covers an adult face
  • An easy, cheap way to theme an Oscars-style party
  • Brilliant for photo booths and group shots
  • Thick 350gsm silk card holds its shape all night
  • Semi-waterproof finish, so it copes with spilt drinks and outdoor parties

Size & details

  • Size: 297 x 210 mm (A4), a full adult-size face
  • Material: 350gsm silk card, full-colour digital print
  • Finish: semi-waterproof
  • Fit: one size for adults; elastic and sticky tabs included
  • Pre-cut eye holes; cut to the shape of the face
  • Packaging: board-backed envelope

Delivery

Printed in our UK workshop and posted to you. Dispatch and postage options are shown at checkout.

Order one for a fancy dress night out, or buy a few so the whole group can turn up as Jimmy Saville.

Please note

This is an unofficial novelty product made for fun and fancy dress. Jimmy Saville has not endorsed, sponsored or approved this product, and Foxy Printing has no connection with them. The name is used only to describe the design.
